WP-07 (ic, M) opened at 5afc4c295 with AC-07.1 and AC-07.2. hv's RULINGS TODAY are hv decisions 19 and 20; vc's are decisions 24 and 25, plus, since: WP-06 builds into a seeded cache under intent/.cache with its symlinks re-pointed and a re-seed on a changed mix.lock; the core forces a full run with no stored run or a run that did not store, records the extractor version it joined against, refreshes the index AFTER the trace, counts dropped by a closed roster of reasons with the conservation law held by an arm, fills a target's location only from exactly one definition row, and treats an absent project as failed only when the language was named; the envelope keeps a key naming several targets at its syntax level with `candidates` while a by-target question still returns it as one of N; `--target` is exact, refuses an unknown target with the nearest ones, takes no hit from a stale file; the Rust workspace root comes from the index's root-most Cargo.toml rows. OWED BY vc: judge the reader, WP-06 and WP-07; bring hv the level-3 population decision (20,113 internal references here only rust-analyzer sees; whether --target can tell an unreferenced target from a misspelt one rides it); hv's word on 0432 and on 0426's drive; the next rebuild and `intent index resolve` driven on this estate; then gen_reference.sh, the gyges run, the trawl and the guards pass.
